verdict.rationale: n8n ships a documented, versioned public REST API (/api/v1) with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, a generated endpoint reference, and interactive playgrounds, so programmatic access is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI, though: no endpoint coverage list, no parity statement, and API versioning without any deprecation or stability policy. missing for 10: evidence that API coverage equals the UI's capabilities (e.g. workflow building, credentials, source control, admin functions), a documented parity commitment, an API changelog or stability policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
